tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Page background. The darkest ground; the black brush strokes of the wordmark come from here.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the boxes in the band portal. One step above the page.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, modals, hovered rows. Sits above bg-surface.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Input fields and code blocks: recessed rather than raised.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. The cream of the wordmark letters. 16.5:1 on bg-base.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels, metadata. 7.4:1 on bg-base — safe for small text.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only. 3.6:1 — never for content that must be read.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. 5.3:1 on accent — use this, not a dark colour.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action, active state, the red of the paint in the logo. As TEXT on bg-base it is only 3.2:1: large text (24px+) and fills only, never body copy.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent on hover and focus.

tokens.name: accent-quiet
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind accent content: selected rows, highlighted show cards.

tokens.name: accent-alt
tokens.usage: Teal from the logo splatter. Secondary accent and links. 6.5:1 on bg-base. Use sparingly — it loses its edge when it appears everywhere.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Dividers, card edges, table rules.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and anything the eye must land on. 3:1 against bg-base.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px, offset 2px. One ring everywhere — on a dark site focus disappears without it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, confirmed, published. Portal only.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unsaved changes, missing rider, incomplete stage plan.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive actions. Lighter than accent so an error never reads as a brand colour.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a chip or tight control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Space above and below a full-bleed section.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Sharp corners match the cut letterforms of the wordmark — use this unless there is a reason not to.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips. Just enough to stop the corner looking broken.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and modals. The largest radius in the system.
